model.name: Ideogram 4.5
model.shortDescription: Generate posters, logos and packaging with accurate in-image text up to 2K, or edit an image with up to four references and an optional mask. Four quality tiers.

inputs.description: Describe the image you want to generate, or the edit to apply, including any text that should appear in it. Refer to input images by position: image 1 is the source, image 2 the first reference, and so on.
inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.name: prompt

inputs.description: Optional images to edit (up to 5, or 4 with a mask). The first is the source image to edit, the others are references. Leave empty to create from your prompt alone.
inputs.label: Reference Images
inputs.name: referenceImages

inputs.description: Optional mask over the first reference image. White marks the region to edit, black the region to keep. Requires Aspect Ratio to stay on Auto.
inputs.label: Mask
inputs.name: mask

inputs.description: The shape of the image. Auto lets the model choose from the prompt and images; Source keeps the first reference image's shape.
inputs.label: Aspect Ratio
inputs.name: aspectRatio

inputs.description: The output resolution when an explicit aspect ratio is set. 1K exists only for 1:1, 4:5, 3:4, 2:3, 5:8, 9:16, 1:2 and their landscape counterparts.
inputs.label: Resolution
inputs.name: resolution

inputs.description: The quality-versus-speed tradeoff. Higher quality takes longer and costs more. Very Low requires a reference image.
inputs.label: Quality
inputs.name: quality

inputs.description: Whether the model enriches your prompt before generating. Applies to text-to-image only: edits are always turned into structured instructions.
inputs.label: Magic Prompt
inputs.name: magicPrompt

inputs.description: How many images to generate (1-8). Each additional image adds to the cost.
inputs.label: Image Count
inputs.name: numOutputs

inputs.description: A number that locks in the randomness of the generation. Leave blank for a new result each time.
inputs.label: Seed
inputs.name: seed

inputs.description: Screens outputs for copyrighted content. Flagged images are withheld. Adds latency.
inputs.label: Copyright Detection
inputs.name: enableCopyrightDetection
